optionExplanations_en: Once the client caches chunk metadata, it doesn't have to ask the manager for location again for chunks it already knows about.
The frontend caching the partition map lets it compute the target partition locally, skipping an extra cross-node lookup before routing.
The manager caching hot chunks serves them straight from memory, cutting the disk I/O it would otherwise repeat on every request.
The CDN caching public blobs answers most reads right at the edge, so origin doesn't take the hit on every single request.

scenario: 公开图片经 CDN 分发，origin 设置 Cache-Control TTL。
scenario_en: Public images are delivered through a CDN, and the origin sets a Cache-Control TTL.
q: TTL 对 CDN 行为意味着什么？
q_en: What does TTL mean for CDN behavior?
options: TTL 内走缓存，过期回源
TTL 删除 origin blob
TTL 自动公开私有对象
TTL 禁止浏览器缓存
options_en: Serve cache within TTL, then refresh from origin
TTL deletes the origin blob
TTL makes private objects public
TTL forbids browser caching
why: TTL 控制边缘缓存的新鲜度窗口，能减少 origin 压力，但也带来缓存旧内容的时间上限。
why_en: TTL defines how long edge caches may serve content before refreshing, reducing origin load with bounded staleness.

termDefinitions.meaning: TTL：缓存项在需要刷新或过期前的有效时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a cached item remains valid before it must refresh or expire.

termDefinitions.meaning: CDN：把内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content in an edge network closer to users.

optionExplanations: 在 TTL 有效期内，边缘节点直接用缓存副本响应，一过期就回源刷新，用一个时间窗口换掉大部分 origin 压力。
TTL 只控制边缘副本何时刷新，不会触发对 origin 上那份 blob 本身的删除。
TTL 管的是缓存新鲜度，跟对象的访问权限是公开还是私有完全是两回事。
TTL 是给缓存设的有效期，浏览器照样可以按自己的缓存策略继续缓存这份内容。
optionExplanations_en: Within the TTL window, the edge just serves the cached copy directly and only goes back to origin once it lapses, trading a bounded staleness window for most of the origin load.
TTL only governs when the edge copy refreshes; it never triggers deleting the actual blob sitting at origin.
TTL controls cache freshness, which is a completely separate concern from whether an object's access is public or private.
TTL sets an expiry window for the cache, but the browser can still cache the content under its own separate caching policy.

q: Blob streaming 如何分段读取大文件？
q_en: How does blob streaming read a large file in pieces?
text: Streaming 按顺序请求 byte ranges：0..X-1、X..2X-1，以 {{range reads}} 方式逐段读取。
text_en: Streaming requests byte ranges in order, such as 0..X-1 and X..2X-1, using {{range reads}}.
why: 分段读取让客户端不用等完整对象下载完才开始处理，也能对失败片段重试。
why_en: Range reads let clients start processing before the whole object is downloaded and retry failed pieces.

scenario: 上传成功返回后，同一集群内所有读者都应看到同一个 blob 视图；远端区域复制可以稍后完成。
scenario_en: After upload succeeds, all readers in the same cluster should see the same blob view, while remote-region replication may finish later.
q: 一致性设计应优先保证哪条路径？
q_en: Which path should the consistency design prioritize?
options: 本集群同步复制并提交 metadata 才返回
先返回成功，再慢慢决定 blob ID 是谁
只复制远端区域，本地反而不复制
读请求可以永远绕开 metadata 查
options_en: The local cluster replicates synchronously and commits metadata before returning
Return success first, then decide the blob ID later
Only replicate to remote regions, not locally
Reads can always bypass metadata entirely
why: 强一致读依赖写路径先完成本地副本和 metadata 提交；远端异步只影响跨区域新鲜度。
why_en: Strong local reads require the write path to commit local replicas and metadata before success is returned.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是可重建的媒体缓存，写后读一致性可以放松来换上传延迟。
tradeoff: 写后读一致性 vs 上传延迟
optionExplanations: 要让本集群内所有读者立刻看到同一个视图，写入就必须先在本地同步复制并提交 metadata，成功返回后这份状态才算数。
先返回成功再慢慢定 blob ID，等于客户端已经拿到确认，但系统这时其实还没决定好这个对象到底是谁。
只复制远端区域不复制本地，本集群内的读者反而看不到刚写入的数据，这跟同集群立即一致正好相反。
读请求要靠 metadata 才能定位 chunk 在哪些 data node 上，绕开它就找不到数据本身。
optionExplanations_en: For every reader in the same cluster to see one consistent view immediately, the write must synchronously replicate locally and commit metadata before returning success.
Returning success and deciding the blob ID later means the client already has a confirmation for an object the system hasn't actually finalized yet.
Replicating only to remote regions and not locally means readers in the same cluster can't see the just-written data — the opposite of same-cluster consistency.
A read needs metadata to know which data nodes hold the chunks; bypass it and there's no way to locate the bytes at all.

scenario: 一个大 blob 被拆成多个 chunks，chunks 分散在多个 data nodes 上，并且每个 chunk 有副本。
scenario_en: A large blob is split into chunks distributed across data nodes, with replicas for each chunk.
q: 这种布局如何提高下载吞吐？
q_en: How does this layout improve download throughput?
options: 客户端可并行从多个 data nodes 拉取不同 chunks
所有 chunks 必须从 manager 串行读取
副本越多 metadata 越少到零
并行读取会自动取消权限检查
options_en: The client can fetch different chunks from multiple data nodes in parallel
All chunks must be read serially from the manager
More replicas reduce metadata to zero
Parallel reads automatically remove authorization
why: 吞吐来自把大对象拆成多条数据流；权限和 chunk map 仍由 metadata 路径控制。
why_en: Throughput improves by splitting the object into parallel data streams while metadata still controls access and locations.
optionExplanations: chunk 分散在不同 data node 上，客户端能同时从多个节点并行拉取不同 chunk，吞吐随并行度往上叠。
manager 只负责给出 chunk map，真正的字节传输走 data nodes，不需要每个 chunk 都串行经过 manager。
副本数量跟 metadata 条目多少是两件事，副本再多，chunk 位置信息该记还是要记。
权限检查在 metadata path 上完成，并行读取只是数据面并发拉取，不会绕开授权判断。
optionExplanations_en: With chunks spread across data nodes, the client can pull different chunks from several nodes at once, so throughput scales with parallelism.
The manager only hands back the chunk map; the actual byte transfer runs through data nodes, with no need to serialize each chunk through the manager.
Replica count and metadata volume are separate things — more replicas doesn't erase the need to still track where each chunk lives.
Authorization is checked on the metadata path; reading chunks in parallel is just concurrent data-plane fetching, it doesn't skip that check.

scenario: 单个 manager 大约只能处理 10,000 QPS 的协调请求，业务继续增长到远超这个量级。
scenario_en: A single manager can handle about 10,000 QPS of coordination requests, and the business grows far beyond that scale.
q: 下一步扩展 manager 的方向是什么？
q_en: What is the next scaling direction for the manager?
options: 分片或联邦 manager
所有请求固定到一个 manager
删除 metadata 服务
客户端直写任意磁盘
options_en: Shard or federate managers
Pin all requests to one manager
Delete the metadata service
Clients write arbitrary disks
why: 单 manager 是协调瓶颈，按命名空间拆分能把 metadata 和放置决策横向扩展。
why_en: Once one manager is the coordination bottleneck, sharding or federation spreads metadata and placement decisions horizontally.
whenOtherWins: 如果 QPS 远低于瓶颈，先用 standby 和 snapshot 提高可用性更划算。
tradeoff: 协调简单性 vs 横向扩展
optionExplanations: 单个 manager 撑到 10,000 QPS 就到顶了，按命名空间分片或联邦多个 manager 能把协调请求横向摊开继续扩容。
所有请求固定到一个 manager 正是当前瓶颈的成因，继续这么做只会让协调请求排队更久。
删掉 metadata 服务等于放弃位置和权限管理，读写都定位不到数据，不是扩展方案。
客户端直接写任意磁盘绕开了 manager 的放置和副本决策，数据一致性和可发现性都没法保证。
optionExplanations_en: One manager tops out around 10,000 QPS, so sharding or federating managers by namespace spreads coordination requests horizontally to keep scaling.
Pinning every request to one manager is exactly what created the bottleneck in the first place; keeping that just queues coordination requests longer.
Deleting the metadata service throws away placement and permission tracking, so nothing can locate data anymore — not a scaling plan.
Having clients write to arbitrary disks skips the manager's placement and replication decisions, so consistency and discoverability both break.

q: 设计 scalable blob store 的一条合理决策链是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable decision chain for designing a scalable blob store?
steps: 用 chunking 和 replica placement 处理大对象与容灾
先定义 container、blobPath、upload/download/delete/list API
把 metadata path 与 blob data path 分离
用 full path partitioning 和 continuation token 支持 listing
用 heartbeat、GC、caching 和 manager standby 补可靠性
why: 我会先定对象模型和 API，再拆控制面/数据面，最后补扩展、列表和故障恢复细节。
why_en: Start with the object API, split control and data paths, then add scaling, listing, and recovery mechanisms.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[API model] --> B[Metadata vs data path]
  B --> C[Chunking + replicas]
  C --> D[Partition + pagination]
  D --> E[Heartbeat + GC + cache + standby]
